## Problem and resulting behavior

Describe a non-sensitive problem, the concrete trigger and the behavior after this change.
Use the verified private reporting route for confidential findings.

## Scope and source

- Base and reviewed source revision:
- Changed behavior and coupled repository/spec/vector/configuration inputs:
- Related non-sensitive issue or overlap decision:
- Required reviewer roles and unresolved authority or compatibility decisions:

## Validation and limits

Record actual checks, exact source, results and scope. Separate local/hosted,
integration, artifacts, deployment and live operation. Make skips, failures,
interrupted work and unperformed gates explicit. Link sanitized evidence only.

## Release and operation impact

State whether release, environment, custody/accounting or chain-rule decisions
are affected and what separate authority/rehearsal is required. A PR and green
checks do not authorize publication, deployment, signing or activation.

## Author declarations

- [ ] Public text and attachments use English and contain no private paths, personal identities, credentials, wallet material or confidential finding details.
- [ ] Unrelated work, licenses and original evidence are preserved.
- [ ] Reported results match the reviewed source and distinguish incomplete work.
- [ ] Required independent review and remaining release/operation gates are stated.

These declarations require review; they are not independent qualification or approval.
